name: Cook a Recipe 🌱🐣
desc:
Welcome to Cook a Recipe 🐣

The Ultimate Farm and Kitchen Tycoon with +1200 Recipes 🧑‍🍳

🍳 Combine ingredients to unlock unique recipes
🌱 Farm your own Food and Ingredients
💵 Sell dishes and get RICH

🐄 Care for animals and collect rare resources
🎣 Catch fish for special ingredients
👥 Play With Friends for Double Rewards! Harvest your friend’s crops and both of you get the ingredients. 
🌙 Progress Even While Offline! 


New recipes, upgrades and features added regularly!
